value.rationale: An explicit 2026 investigation of arithmetic-subderivative iterations identifies periodic points beyond fixed points as an open research direction. The statement rules out least period two uniformly for every distinct pair of primes, giving the first possible nontrivial period >=3 wherever a nontrivial orbit exists.
